# Arduino-Based Touchless Smart Dustbin System&nbsp;

&nbsp;

# Aim

To construct an automated, hands-free smart dustbin utilizing an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor and a micro servo motor interfaced with an Arduino Uno to prevent direct physical contact and improve hygiene.

&nbsp;

Components&nbsp;

![][image1]
![image1](componentservo.png)
&nbsp;

## Working:

**Sensing Hand / Object:** The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor continuously emits high-frequency sound pulses via its transmitter. When a user approaches or brings their hand within a predefined threshold (typically\<25-30cm), the echo bounces back and is received by the sensor.

**Signal Computation:** The Arduino measures the duration between transmission and reception using the pulseIn() function and computes the distance:

CODE

\#include \<Servo.h\>

&nbsp;

const int trigPin \= 10;

const int echoPin \= 9;

const int servoPin \= 5;

&nbsp;

Servo dustbinServo;

&nbsp;

long duration;

int distance;

const int thresholdDistance \= 25; // Detection threshold in cm

&nbsp;

void setup() {

&nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(trigPin, OUTPUT);

&nbsp;&nbsp;pinMode(echoPin, INPUT);

&nbsp;&nbsp;dustbinServo.attach(servoPin);

&nbsp;&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;dustbinServo.write(0); // Initial closed state

&nbsp;&nbsp;Serial.begin(9600);

}

&nbsp;

void loop() {

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Clear trigPin

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

&nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(2);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Send 10us ultrasonic pulse

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, HIGH);

&nbsp;&nbsp;delayMicroseconds(10);

&nbsp;&nbsp;digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Read echo reflection time

&nbsp;&nbsp;duration \= pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH);

&nbsp;&nbsp;distance \= duration \* 0.0343 / 2;

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;// Check if hand/object is within range

&nbsp;&nbsp;if (distance \> 0 && distance \<= thresholdDistance) {

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dustbinServo.write(90);  // Open lid

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay(4000);             // Keep lid open for 4 seconds

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;dustbinServo.write(0);   // Close lid

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;delay(1000);             // Brief debounce delay

&nbsp;&nbsp;}

&nbsp;

&nbsp;&nbsp;delay(100);

}

&nbsp;

**Applications**

* **Healthcare Facilities & Hospitals:** Minimizes cross-contamination and nosocomial infections by eliminating handle contact.  
* **Smart Homes & Offices:** Provides an effortless, modern, and sanitary waste-disposal mechanism in kitchens, bathrooms, and cubicles.  
* **Public & Educational Institutions:** Prevents overflow touch points and encourages proper waste disposal in schools, colleges, and food courts.

**Result**

The smart dustbin automation circuit was successfully built and tested. The system detected approaching obstacles within the 25cm range and actuated the servo motor smoothly to open the lid, successfully closing it after a timed delay.
